fact: The Office of the Auditor General states the FGS uses SFMIS as its main PFM system for public expenditure control and for generating the financial statements submitted for audit; a follow-up audit covered application controls, IT controls, security and business continuity for the year ended 31 December 2023.
title: Follow-up Report on the Audit of the Somali Financial Management Information System
publisher: Office of the Auditor General of the Federal Republic of Somalia
